title: GRUT-RAI: Consolidated Theory Public Record (source boundary 25 September 2026)
description:
Public-record release of the GRUT (Grand Responsive Universe Theory) research program at a consolidation point, together with the GRUT-RAI computational and provenance infrastructure that produced it.

The central document is GRUT — Grand Responsive Universe Theory: Consolidated Theory, Formal Architecture, Results, Limits, and Completion Program (uploads/GRUT_Consolidated_Theory_PUBLIC_RECORD.md and .pdf). It states, at the source boundary master-w25bu9 @ 6abbf316, what the program has constructed within declared model classes (continuum spectral structure, memory, and effective irreversibility from strictly local finite dynamics; an influence hierarchy that is complete as an interface in class; access-relative reconstruction of tested geometry; a finite stepped nonstationary extension of the core construction), what remains a supplied primitive input (access seed, massless gauge/Lorentz probe structure, universal reach, co-stretch declaration, cross-sector light cone, hbar, Born measure, noncommutativity, states and boundary data, microscopic sector content), the unresolved seams, and every preserved failed pre-registered gate.

Scope statement: this is an in-house research record. No external peer review is claimed. No experimental validation is claimed. No confirmed novel quantitative prediction is claimed. It is not a completed theory of everything. Earlier releases in this lineage carried stronger claims that the current record has demoted; where they conflict, this record supersedes them (see Section 29 of the document).

The repository snapshot includes all frozen charters, executable pure-stdlib instruments (calc/), sha-hashed result artifacts, verdicts, and formalizations cited by the document; owner rulings are recorded on GitHub Issue #2.
